newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenyin Wanguo in rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Shenyin Wanguo in rights issue.

text.p: Financial services group Shenyin Wanguo (H.K.) Ltd said on Thursday it planned to raise net proceeds of about HK$158 million in a rights issue of 166.59 million new shares to fund business expansion.

Shenyin Wanguo, formerly named Shanghai International (H.K.) Ltd, said in a statement it proposed to distribute the rights shares on the basis of one new share for every two existing shares held at HK$1.00 per rights share.
Shenyin Wanguo shares ended at HK$1.34 on Wednesday.

A total 66.64 million warrants will also be issued under the rights issue in the proportion of four warrants for every 10 rights shares held. Full exercise of the warrants will result in the issue of 66.64 million new shares or 13.3 percent of the enlarged issued share capital, the company said.
Each warrant which expires on June 30, 1998, entitles holders to subscribe to the company shares at an initial subscription price of HK$1.04 per share, subject to adjustment.

Of the HK$158 million in net proceeds, HK$80 million will be used to expand the company's share margin financing business and the balance will be for working capital to strengthen the company's capital base.

Shenyin Wanguo, a financial services company, said its 55.35 percent controlling shareholder Shenyin Wanguo Holdings (B.V.I.) Ltd and its parent's major shareholder Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co Ltd, which holds 1.47 percent of the company, have undertaken to accept in full of their alloted portions of rights shares.
